--gate-extra-source FILE (repeatable): declarations of gate modules imported by the gate module (same namespace) join the gate block table, so fresh callees defined in an imported gate module are compared with the compiled gate constants. --gate-namespace NS: multi-namespace gate support. extract_namespace() keeps the header and the concatenated content of all top-level `namespace NS ... end NS` blocks (a name may repeat); other namespaces are dropped from the block table and recorded as gate_other_namespaces in the report; nested namespaces inside the selected block stay content.
